response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS value FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_rate_per_day, ra.film_count, ra.avg_rate_per_day / b.value AS relative_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A 5-day rental qualifies as long; the cutoff is inclusive.

alternatives.interpretation: Only rentals longer than 5 days qualify.
